name: 49-border-longhand-bottom-left
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.6; font-size: 15px; } .bb { border-bottom: 6px double #3366cc; padding-bottom: 4px; background-color: #eef3ff; } .bl { border-left: 8px solid #cc3366; padding-left: 10px; background-color: #ffeef3; }
html:
border-bottom 6px double：下边框参与盒高。
border-left 8px solid：左边框占宽，首行起点右移。
